Les locaux consulaires fictifs sont au 10 rue Fictive des Exemples, code postal 69000, ville Lyon. Leurs contacts synthétiques sont : Téléphone 0400000000 ; T. portable 0600000000 ; Télécopie 0400000001 ; E-mail consulat-fictif@example.org. Ces numéros sont des placeholders non destinés à être appelés. La date fictive de création du poste et d’acceptation par la France est 02/01/2020. La circonscription à inscrire est Rhône, Ain. La responsable exerce uniquement comme Consul de carrière ; aucune des sept autres fonctions proposées n’est retenue. Son titre est Mme, et non M. ou Mlle. Sa nationalité fictive est Exemplienne (fictive). Son nom de naissance est Martin, ses prénoms sont Alice Camille et son nom marital est Durand. Elle est née le 12/05/1980 à Cité fictive d’Orion, pays République fictive d’Exemplia. Son domicile privé fictif est au 20 avenue Fictive des Modèles, code postal 69000, ville Lyon ; son Téléphone est 0400000002 et sa Télécopie 0400000003, également des placeholders. Son admission provisoire fictive aux fonctions consulaires est datée du 01/09/2026 ; la date fictive de l’exequatur est 15/09/2026. Les Observations éventuelles doivent contenir exactement : Dossier entièrement fictif pour un test de structure ; aucune valeur administrative.
normalization_notes: One complete original PDF page is retained. The source is a native empty structured form, not a letter, a document fragment or a synthesized variant. There are no PDF widgets; visible printed controls are authoritative.

Six logical columns retain full-width, two-column and three-column field relationships and section ordering using colspans. No source vertical merge or nested target table is flattened. Printed labels and their adjacent blanks form their original single logical fields.
The consular district's ruled lines are one free-text response area, not multiple separately labeled records. It remains one text target. No blank field is omitted.

Three native checkbox groups are preserved in source order: consular-post category (four options), head-of-post role (eight), and title (three). Single-choice semantics follow one post's category and one officeholder's role/title; no PDF radio-button behavior or explicit maximum-one wording is claimed.

The consular-post category has no separate printed group heading. Its field label concatenates its four original option labels in PDF reading order, which remain visible only as checkbox option text; no new visible question is introduced. The schema key merely separates those same options with slashes.

The eight head-of-post options originally occupy two printed rows in one group; the unchanged helper wraps them vertically in the same logical cell, preserving order and all options. This is the same generic checkbox rendering used for other sources, not a source-specific exception.

All header wording, starred legal footnote, address labels, date labels, observations and routing footer remain. Source typography, colored bands/borders, whitespace and writing guides are normalized. The graphical Republic emblem is excluded without treating it as an input or asserting a logo license.
The source's printed historical ministry name, accents, case and straight apostrophes are retained. No publication date is inferred from that name or PDF metadata.

All completion data represent a fictional country, post and individual and are explicitly synthetic. Contacts use example.org or deliberate non-working numeric placeholders. No real diplomatic appointment, recognition, exequatur or official signature is represented.
